# Skill (Anthropic)

Anthropic says skill in the industry's sense of a [skill][industry.skill]: "Skills extend what Claude can do. Create a SKILL.md file with instructions, and Claude adds it to its toolkit", and "Claude Code skills follow the Agent Skills open standard" ([Skills][a6]). A skill's description stays in context and its body loads when the skill is used.

## Examples

- Claude Code skills, into which custom commands have been merged ([Skills][a6]).
